approach: Fix the definition, never the section name — git history shows the entry-point reading was authored at origin (ba974085) and the owner has read it as a use case since; renaming would entrench the smaller job

Constrain every candidate shape to gradable-from-the-document — the spec gate is a cold judge, so facilitation rituals (event storming, JTBD interviews, BMAD elicitation) are out of reach whatever their merit
Carry the entry-point rows forward rather than replacing them; they are correct and the CR adds to them
Hold the 85-node corpus backfill out (#436) so legacy debt never blocks an in-flight CR
Land the grading duty across Oracle, Builder and Architect per owner ruling, not in Oracle alone as first scoped
Route confidence-derivation, bar-invocation timing, and claim provenance to follow-ups — each is its own CR

why.floor: none — the net diff against main is ADDITIVE on the one frozen suite (addOnly true, 16 added / 0 modified / 0 removed, confirmed structurally by gherkin-cli diff, not read off the line diff), so the @frozen tag self-clears and nothing narrowed. No Clearance owed. The four other revised spec nodes are spec-type reference and own no suite
why.blast: medium — one behavioral node's own section plus the three spec-gate actor bars and the shipped spec-format bar, which every future CR loads. It adds no engine, no mechanical check and no new gate stage, and the 85-node corpus is deliberately untouched (#436), so no in-flight CR inherits a bar its node has not adopted
why.novelty: medium — the four-part use case is codification of established requirements practice (Jacobson/Cockburn actor+goal+extensions) rather than an invented axis, and the surface trace reuses this repo's shipped orphan-detection pattern from the scenario map one level up. What is new here is binding the three actor bars to it, each in its own domain rather than as a shared copy
why.confidence: high — cold sdd-spec-judge round 2 returned ALIGNED true with oracle/builder/architect all PASS, no blocker, no failing scenario, no live open marker. The judge re-derived both round-1 remediations independently rather than accepting them: it re-ran the revised-node sweep (5 revised, 4 reference-type, so the single instance was the complete set) and the mirrored-duty sweep across all three new bar duties. It checked the node's surface trace 1:1 against the governance's actual Inputs block and found no invented element, and confirmed all 8 stated extensions map to real procedure text and each carries a scenario. It pressed the two struck self-defects for work-dodging and cleared both on independent evidence — the USER_INPUT/BACKFILL pair reads as a precedence in step 1 rather than a refusal, and the Clearance stop is already specified on mission/conductor, the node that owns it. It miss-tested all 6 round-2 scenarios and named the wrong subject that loses on the no-CFG arm (an implementation iterating an empty edge set and reporting every extension unreachable). Regression check explicit and clean. check:spec 6/6 reproduced independently, pnpm verify 29/29
why.conformance: warn — authoring/spec-producer carries no ## What, ## Control Flow or ## Scenario map. Confirmed pre-existing at origin/main and non-blocking; deriving a CFG here would be a retrofit against prose written in this same CR, so it rides the follow-up machinery

note: The authoring/spec-producer node carries no ## What, ## Control Flow or ## Scenario map. Pre-existing at the merge base and surfaced by both gates as a non-blocking conformance warning. Deriving a CFG inside this CR would retrofit it against prose the same CR authored, which is the shape that has diverged before.

Extend the scope and structural-fit bars to judge the SHAPE of a designed surface, not only that each element traces to a use case: minimality, orthogonality, consistent naming. Traceability answers whether an element is justified; it does not answer whether the set of elements is well formed, which is the half of the reported defect this CR does not reach.

Guide a project through binding its own scope, coverage and structural-fit bars at onboarding. Five roles and five bars are bindable per artifact-type today, but nothing walks an adopter through choosing them, so every project inherits the defaults by default rather than by decision. Open question recorded: the doctrine and structure delegates are not bindable at all, and whether they should be is undecided.

Derive the confidence dimension from measurable inputs instead of free prose. Blast already has an engine that computes it and flags an under- or over-called declaration; confidence is self-asserted and unchecked, and it is the dimension that decides whether an agent proceeds alone or stops for a human.

Reconsider when the actor bars are invoked. They run twice, both times over the artifact as it stands, so a judge can confirm every element is covered but can never ask whether an element should exist. The design record that would carry that interrogation is optional, ungated and out of the judge's view, and two of the corpus's change requests have written one.

Require a problem claim to carry its source: reported by the request, observed with a citation, or assumed. Evidenced by one reverted change request that passed both gates and a mutation sweep on a situation that had already been adjudicated, and by a second whose stale premise was caught only because the producer went and measured. Nothing at the gate distinguished the two.
